articles.title: Defence ministry may clear proposals worth over Rs 1 lakh crore today
articles.summary: The Defence Ministry is set to approve over Rs 1 lakh crore for significant military acquisitions. Key procurements include 300 K-9 Vajra howitzers for artillery, 600 HAMMER missiles to enhance fighter jet capabilities, and Russian Verba air defence systems for the Army. This major push aims to modernize India's armed forces, boost indigenous defence production, and strengthen national security.

articles.title: Goodyear Blimp sails above NYC like ship in the water ahead of July Fourth party
articles.summary: America's 250th birthday celebration in New York City featured the iconic Goodyear Blimp soaring above a grand fleet of warships, tall ships, and ferries. This monumental event marked a significant national milestone, showcasing a majestic parade both in the air and on the water, highlighting the nation's rich maritime history and ongoing festivities.

articles.title: Army stops Kuki protesters near Naga blockade point in Manipur
articles.summary: The Indian Army recently intervened in Manipur, halting Kuki protesters near a Naga community blockade point. This deployment underscores the military's role in managing internal security and maintaining law and order amidst ethnic tensions. Such actions are crucial to prevent escalation and ensure stability in sensitive regions prone to civil unrest.

articles.summary: Analysis indicates a potential decline in US influence across Europe, creating a perceived power vacuum within NATO. Turkish President Erdogan is reportedly seeking to capitalize on this shift, aiming to expand Turkey's strategic presence and fill the void. This geopolitical development signifies evolving dynamics within the transatlantic alliance, presenting a critical current affairs topic for SSB aspirants.

articles.title: Digital Edge (India) buys 30 acres in Palava for Rs 1,000 cr, plans 270MW data centre
articles.summary: Digital Edge (India), backed by the NIIF, has acquired over 30 acres of land in Palava near Mumbai. This land, within Lodha Developers' Green Integrated Data Centre Park, is for establishing advanced data centres. This move signifies a major investment in India's digital infrastructure, boosting its capacity and supporting the nation's growing digital economy.
